{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Cor'ika'', we've got a hundred and fifty ''shabla'' contingency rules, everything from arresting the Chancellor if he goes gaga to reducing key allied worlds to slag if they switch sides&hellip;|[[Atin Skirata|RC-3222]], to [[Corr Skirata|RC-5108/8843]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Etain Tur-Mukan]]|<ref name="Order 66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>}}
'''Order 65''' was one of the [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|150 contingency orders]] that the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] were trained to carry out in the event of different emergency scenarios during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Order 65 stated that if a majority of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] or the [[Senate Security Council|Security Council]] declared that the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]]&mdash;at that [[Time/Legends|time]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]&mdash;was unfit for duty, the Chancellor was to be arrested or, if necessary, [[Death/Legends|killed]].

==Description==
{{Quote|In the event of either (i) a majority in the Senate declaring the Supreme Commander (Chancellor) to be unfit to issue orders, or (ii) the Security Council declaring him to be unfit to issue orders, and an authenticated order being received by the GAR, commanders shall be authorized to detain the Supreme Commander, with lethal force if necessary, and command of the GAR shall fall to the acting Chancellor until a successor is appointed or alternative authority identified as outlined in Section 6 (iv).|Order 65|<ref name="TC" />}}
Order 65 was the sixty-fifth of the [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|150 contingency orders]] developed by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Like all 150 contingency orders&mdash;which dealt with a variety of different emergency situations&mdash;the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the Grand [[Army/Legends|Army]] were trained to carry out Order 65 without hesitation.<ref name="TC" />

Order 65 stated that if either a majority of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] or the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Senate Security Council|Security Council]] deemed the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]]&mdash;the [[Supreme Commander (Republic)|Supreme Commander]] of the Grand Army and an office held by [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during the war&mdash;unfit for duty, and if the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] forces directly received Order 65, then the army was to immediately arrest or, if needed, [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Chancellor. Following this, command of the Grand Army would be given to the acting Chancellor until a stable replacement could be chosen.<ref name="TC" />

==History==
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], 995 days after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Atin Skirata|RC-3222]] indirectly mentioned Order 65 to squadmate [[Corr Skirata|RC-5108/8843]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Etain Tur-Mukan]] during a conversation over the Grand Army's 150 contingency orders at the Republic's [[Special Operations Brigade Headquarters]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Order 66" /> However, Order 65 was never implemented during the Clone Wars.<ref name="TC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Order 65 was first mentioned in the [[Karen Traviss]] novel ''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''&mdash;published in [[October]] [[2007]]&mdash;when the full text of the contingency order was stated at the beginning of the novel's twentieth chapter.<ref name="TC" /> Order 65 was later indirectly mentioned in the novel ''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]'', published in [[September]] [[2008]].<ref name="Order 66" />

===Non-canon appearance===
Order 65 was also mentioned in a non-[[canon]] [[Star Wars Miniatures: The Clone Wars advertisement|advertisement]] for the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (Star Wars Miniatures)|''Star Wars Miniatures: The Clone Wars'']] set in [[Star Wars Insider 105|''Star Wars Insider'' 105]], released in [[December]] 2008.<ref name="SWM advert">[[Star Wars Miniatures: The Clone Wars advertisement|''Star Wars Miniatures: The Clone Wars'' advertisement]]</ref>

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
Sometime around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> after killing the [[Jedi hunter/Legends|Jedi hunter]] [[Durge/Legends|Durge]] and disabling the Separatist [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] in battle, a group of clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] under the command of [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] wondered what their next orders were going to be. As the clones and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Tano were walking away from the immobilized Grievous, one of the clone troopers asked his squadmates whether they were up to either [[Order 64]] or Order 65.<ref name="SWM advert" />
{{Noncanonend}}
